plan.change: Issue #889 phase 2: isolate the asynchronous IDB commit barrier, with no active game code changed
expectedChanges: Create a separate, testable async commit barrier for the future game-mode IDB integration; it rejects all intervening actions while writing and never exposes the candidate as committed before durable transaction+readback completes.

Only one current candidate/revision token. On failure do not call apply; stop game and require controlled recovery from previously committed or cold IDB read. On success apply exactly once and advance revision monotonically; exception during apply is fatal/inconsistent and prevents further operations.

Add Node tests with delayed writer, concurrent input rejection, transaction failure/abort, stale revision, postcommit readback uncertainty and callback exceptions. No production or game-runtime changes.
ownerDecisions: 2026-11-10 owner approved AmberTime storage repair after second iPhone Chrome quota stop; iPhone Chrome screenshot confirms v8 154 month IndexedDB preflight exact-match.
No authorization to change production or delete original storage.
hqDecisions: Build pure non-UI commit barrier before introducing asynchronous clock and full action refactor; current game must remain on synchronous localStorage until a separate reviewed Plan.
Treat a write that may have committed before a readback or callback error as uncertain; no auto retry or rollback that could clobber a newer transaction.
Do not process queued user actions after a failed save. Tokens/revision and double-click handling are controlled by one barrier.
manualChecks: No iPhone runtime effects in this PR; later integrated Staging prototype must perform actual iPhone Chrome click/clock/quota/readback tests.

plan.problem: Preflight has proved 154-month v8 JSON survives isolated IndexedDB on iPhone, but shop-app.mjs currently assumes synchronous saveCandidate and would commit game state before an async save settles.
plan.currentContract: Game advances and emits notifications only after synchronous validated localStorage writeCandidate succeeds. All input and clock flows assume that Boolean contract.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Staging formal-idb-storage.mjs provides an async transaction but cannot be injected directly into synchronous call sites without truthy Promise, duplicate clock work, and lost last-good snapshot.
plan.design: A minimal pure async barrier that invokes prepare with current revision, awaits durable writer+readback, rejects overlap while in-flight, atomically publishes next revision to its own token and only then invokes commit callback once. On error moves to locked fail-stop; no optimistic current game changes or automatic retry.
plan.migration: None. Prototype module only; game integration and original localStorage-to-IDB migration require a separate Plan.
plan.compatibility: No change to v8 session bytes, format, game model, reader or writer. Module accepts the IDB writer as a dependency for subsequent integration.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging-only unreferenced module with Node verification; no public gameplay or release change.
